evidence.description: Report number 26-072259. States date of incident Wednesday, January 28, 2026; approximate time 01:57; location the 8500 block of Richmond Highway, Woodlawn, Fairfax County, VA; premises type cell phone store.
Responding officer arrived at the store and contacted the reporting party. Point of entry examination found the front window broken with a rock and the suspect entered. Cash register stolen.
Surveillance footage is recorded as capturing the whole incident. One photograph is attached to the report. Footage content is not described beyond this.
Front window broken with a rock and the suspect entered.

A large white body is partly visible at the upper-left edge of the frame, possibly a box truck, van, or trailer. Only a fragment shows, so its body style cannot be confirmed. A red edge appears at the lower-right corner and a white edge at the lower-left, which may belong to a vehicle or structure outside the frame. Confidence is low.
